review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form; encourage a substantially narrower new submission rather than another ordinary revision

remote_execution.workflow_name: NBO R8 integrated manuscript and evidence

limitations: Random inclusion tests and differential-evolution lower bounds are stress tests, not a formal proof.
The reviewer did not independently rerun the entire 1447-second tight action cover from scratch.
The exact stored source, arrays, logs and remote workflow artifact were inspected and cross-checked.

blocking_findings: The actor contribution is not identified; actor-free search is faster, cheaper and at least as accurate on the principal continuous experiment.
All nine complete continuous-action policy bounds miss the displayed 0.1 uniform target.
The complete-action verifier is budget-saturated at every time step and dominates total computation cost.
Continuous-state/time transfer defects remain uncomputed, while full-domain refinement losses grow to 1.566 and 2.123.
Strong classical, projection and direct baselines dominate where complete verification is available.
The theory provides a careful error-accounting synthesis but no distinct convergence, complexity or stability result for NBO training.
No experiment is simultaneously high-dimensional, nonlinear, actor-trained, strongly benchmarked and independently certified.
